t: The Forever Machine: Architecting Digital Sovereignty in the Age of AI
s: This article proposes a 'Forever Machine' philosophy to combat AI-driven platform churn and dependency traps. It champions digital sovereignty through reproducible environments and text-file-driven architectures, empowering individuals to own and maintain their creations.
sub: AI-amplified 'idea man' + 'technician' combo for digital creation
Contrast between ephemeral 'vibe coding' and durable 'bottling it' (sovereign software)
Nix as a bedrock for reproducible environments and hardware abstraction ('normalized Linux')
The 'LPvg' (Linux, Python, vim, git) stack for anti-churn and longevity
Pipulate's 'magic cookie' system for self-bootstrapping and easy distribution of sovereign apps
